m.s: Heat the oven to 220°C. Cut {potato} into small chunks and toss with oil, salt and chopped {rosemary} on a lined tray. Roast for 35 minutes, turning halfway, until golden and crisp.
Bash {pork_cutlets} out to about 1cm thick between two sheets of baking paper, leaving the bone on. Season both sides with salt and pepper.
Mix {panko} with grated {parm*0.5}. Dust the cutlets in {flour}, dip in beaten {eggs}, then press firmly into the crumbs on both sides.

Heat 1cm of oil with {butter} in a large frying pan over medium-high heat. Fry the cutlets for 3 to 4 minutes a side until deep golden and just cooked through, with no pink at the bone. Rest on a rack so the bottom stays crisp.
Toss {rocket} and halved {cherrytom} with the juice of {lemon*0.5}, a drizzle of oil and a pinch of salt. Shave the rest of the parmesan over.
Serve each cutlet with a big lemon wedge, the salad piled on top and the potatoes alongside.

l: Slice the cutlet and pack with the salad. Reheat in the oven or air fryer to keep it crisp. Keeps 3 days in the fridge.
g: GF flour and crumbs, crumbed and fried first in fresh oil.
